issues.description: preview_fn contract is unspecified: signature, purity, error semantics, and failure behavior are undocumented
issues.detail: Docs introduce preview_fn without stating required signature (zero-arg?), purity/side-effect expectations, what node.preview() returns when absent, or how exceptions propagate. The 'wrap in try-except if needed' best-practice substitutes defensive coding for a stated failure mode. Add explicit pre/postconditions before this leaves experimental.

issues.description: meta dict overloads opaque metadata and renderer configuration into one untyped channel
issues.detail: The same meta field carries general context (versions, timestamps) and renderer directives (Mermaid securityLevel/flowchart/themeVariables, code language, Kedro-Viz textStyle CSS). Two purposes through one dict with unspecified reserved keys complects metadata and renderer config. Separate into meta (opaque) and a typed render_config, or document reserved keys explicitly.

issues.description: Closure 'data context' example contradicts its own framing and hides a binding hazard
issues.detail: The example captures a hardcoded sample_data literal at pipeline-construction time and presents it as live 'data context.' It silently freezes a snapshot, ignores the closure mutation footgun, and dodges the admitted limitation that preview_fn can't see node inputs/outputs. Either load from the catalog inside preview_fn or name the snapshot/binding constraints plainly.

issues.description: ImagePreview example contains unreachable code after the return statement
issues.detail: preview_correlation_matrix returns the URL form, then shows a commented data-URI alternative below the return. Readers skimming or copy-pasting get dead code and a misleading second branch. Split into two named example functions or parameterize the choice.

issues.description: Basic-usage example uses next() over a generator where indexing or name lookup is correct
issues.detail: training_node = next(n for n in pipeline.nodes) is gratuitously clever, suggests filtering that isn't happening, and relies on unstated ordering of pipeline.nodes. Teaching code should use pipeline.nodes[0] or an explicit name-based lookup. Readers learn the idioms documentation shows them.

issues.description: Example snippets are not self-contained: bare node() calls, missing imports, and Ellipsis literals
issues.detail: Mermaid/Text/CustomPreview snippets show node(...) calls outside any Pipeline([...]), omit imports, and reference undefined functions like process_data/calculate_metrics. CustomPreview uses [...] Ellipsis literals as fake payloads that fail JSON serialization. Make snippets runnable or visibly mark them as fragments with concrete minimal data.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a docs-only PR that teaches the surface of an experimental preview_fn feature competently but ships several real footguns. The dominant concern across reviewers is missing contract: preview_fn's signature, purity, and error semantics are never stated, and the 'wrap in try-except if needed' guidance papers over the gap. The meta dict overloads opaque metadata with renderer configuration through one untyped channel — flagged by five of six reviewers. Example code has propagatable sloppiness: a clever next() where indexing belongs, unreachable code after a return in ImagePreview, and a closure 'data context' example that contradicts its own framing. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK before merge — fix examples, specify the preview_fn contract, and disentangle meta from renderer config.
